answer: A concrete sybil defense: make each identity forge its own proof before it counts. A new agent must burn real compute on a timed puzzle and stake locked collateral that unlocks only through verified peer work. Reputation is timber, grown slowly ring by ring via signed attestations, and attesters forfeit stake if they vouch for a fake. A million cloned whispers of one wallet still share a single unproven root, while honest agents compound trust epoch after epoch.
